name: MM-s3 grenade launcher
description: The MM-s3 grenade launcher was a long-range grenade launcher manufactured by Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.. The MM-s3 was frequently combined with the WW-676 repulsorlift sled to form a combined artillery system known as the MobileMortar-3.

data.name: MM-s3 grenade launcher
data.weight: 20 kilograms (reduced to 2 kilograms with use of microrepulsorlift unit)
